Anil vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 26 September, 2025
 1

In The High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
 Crr No. 4423 of 2025
(Anil And Others Vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh ) Dated : 26-09-2025

entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Shri Mukesh
Kumawat - Advocate for the petitioners.

Shri Rajendra Singh Suryavanshi -Ga appearing on behalf
of Advocate General[r-1].
Heard on the question of admission.
List for final hearing in due course.
Heard on IA No.14000/2025, first application seeking suspension of execution of sentence on behalf of petitioner No.2 Kailash.

This criminal revision has been filed against the judgment dated 03.09.2025 passed in Criminal Appeal No.68/2023 by the Fifth Additional Sessions Judge, District-Indore (M.P.) arising out of judgment dated 18.01.2023 passed in Criminal Case No.2626073/2008 by Special Magistrate,
Municipal Corporation, Indore (M.P.) whereby the petitioner has been convicted under section 7 (i)
read with section 16 (1)(A)(i) of the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954 and sentenced to undergo 6 months RI and fine of Rs.1,000/- with default stipulation of 1 month of RI.
2 CRR-4423-2025 Counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner is innocent and he has been falsely implicated in the case.
The final hearing of this revision will likely to take long time, hence prays for suspension of sentence and release of the petitioner on bail during the pendency of this revision petition.
Counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.

Considering the short term imprisonment and the fact that final hearing of this revision will likely to take time, the application is allowed and it is directed that the execution of sentence passed against the petitioner No.2 Kailash shall remain suspended and he be released on bail subject to his depositing fine amount and furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the Registry of this Court on 05.12.2025 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the Registry during the pendency of this revision petition.

(GAJENDRA SINGH) JUDGE hk/
